description: MCP server with 82 tools for .NET code analysis, refactoring, code generation, and quality analysis
releaseNotes:
v1.1.0 - Code Quality Analysis

      🚀 MAJOR NEW FEATURES:
        • ✨ Code Smell Detection - 12 detectors (Long Method, Large Class, Circular Dependency, etc.)
        • 📊 Technical Debt Quantification - Debt ratio, fix time estimation, trend analysis
        • 🔍 Change Impact Analysis - Analyze impact of code changes
        • 👁️ Visualization - Dependency graphs, architecture heatmaps
        • 🎯 File Watching - Incremental analysis with cache support
        • 📈 Quality Reports - Comprehensive quality metrics

      📊 STATISTICS:
        • MCP Tools: 74 → 82 (+8 new tools)
        • New Detectors: 12 code smell detectors
        • Lines of Code: ~15,000 → ~18,000 (+3,000)
        • Backward Compatible: Yes (no breaking changes)

      🎯 NEW TOOLS:
        • detect_code_smells - Detect code smells with severity classification
        • quantify_technical_debt - Calculate technical debt metrics
        • generate_quality_report - Generate comprehensive quality report
        • analyze_change_impact - Analyze impact of code changes
        • start_file_watching / stop_file_watching - File monitoring
        • generate_dependency_graph - Dependency graph visualization
        • generate_heatmap - Architecture heatmap generation
        • get_cache_statistics - Cache management

      🔧 IMPROVEMENTS:
        • Parallel code analysis support
        • Analysis result caching (memory + persistent)
        • File watching with debounce mechanism
        • Analysis timeout control
        • Enhanced error handling and logging

      📝 DOCUMENTATION:
        • Complete code quality analysis documentation
        • Updated API reference
        • New usage examples

      v1.0.1 - Documentation Optimization

      📝 IMPROVEMENTS:
        • 📖 Created ARCHITECTURE.md with detailed system diagrams
        • 🎯 Simplified README.md - removed complex Mermaid charts
        • 📊 Moved all architecture diagrams to dedicated documentation
        • 📦 Improved NuGet package README readability

      📊 CHANGES:
        • README.md: Reduced from 900 to ~700 lines
        • Created docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with:
          - System architecture diagram
          - Core component relationships
          - Project structure visualization
          - MCP tool hierarchy
          - Tool call flow sequence diagram
        • Added architecture section link in README

      v1.0.0 - Official Release

      🎯 MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS:
        • ✨ Added 4 code quality analysis tools (test coverage, dead code detection, performance analysis, documentation generation)
        • 📊 Call graph visualization supports SVG, JSON, Mermaid formats
        • 🌐 Localization support - error messages in Chinese and English
        • 🔧 ToolBase base class reduces code duplication
        • ⚡ Achieved 0 warnings, 0 errors build
        • ✅ All tests passing

      📊 STATISTICS:
        • MCP Tools: 70 → 74 (+4)
        • New Analysis Tools: 4
        • Test Pass Rate: 100%

      v0.8.0 - Framework Expansion & Dependency Optimization

      🎯 MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS:
        • ✨ Added .NET 10.0 support (C# 14)
        • 📦 Unified Roslyn to version 5.0.0 across all frameworks
        • 🔧 Removed conditional PackageReference compilations
        • ⚡ Achieved 0 warnings, 0 errors build
        • ✅ All tests passing (171 tests on net9.0/net10.0, 190 on net8.0)

      📊 FRAMEWORK SUPPORT:
        • .NET 8.0 (C# 12) - 190/190 tests passing ✅
        • .NET 9.0 (C# 13) - 171/171 tests passing ✅
        • .NET 10.0 (C# 14) - 171/171 tests passing ✅
        • Dropped .NET Standard 2.0 (incompatible with modern Roslyn)

      🔧 DEPENDENCIES:
        • Roslyn: Unified to 5.0.0 (was: 4.14.0 on net8.0, 5.0.0 on net9.0)
        • Removed BenchmarkDotNet (unused, causing NU1608 warnings)
        • All NU1608 package version conflicts resolved

      🐛 BUG FIXES:
        • Fixed WorkspaceManager conditional compilation (NET8_0 → all frameworks)
        • Fixed 23 test failures on .NET 10.0
        • Removed null reference warnings

      v0.7.0 - Complete Feature Implementation

      🎉 Major Release - All Planned Features Completed

      ✨ NEW MCP TOOLS (29 total):
        Phase 3 - Refactoring Tools (11):
        • field_encapsulator - Encapsulate fields as properties
        • interface_extractor - Extract interface from class
        • signature_changer - Modify method signatures
        • parameter_adder - Add parameters to methods
        • temporary_inliner - Inline temporary variables
        • as_remover - Remove unnecessary 'as' conversions
        • unnecessary_code_remover - Remove unreachable code
        • for_to_foreach_converter - Convert for to foreach
        • foreach_to_for_converter - Convert foreach to for
        • if_to_switch_converter - Convert if-else to switch
        • for_reverser - Reverse for loop direction

        Phase 4 - Code Generation (6):
        • generate_interface_impl - Generate interface implementations
        • generate_constructor - Generate constructors from fields
        • generate_property - Generate properties
        • remove_unused_usings - Remove unused using directives
        • sort_usings - Sort using statements
        • add_missing_imports - Add missing imports

        Phase 5 - Advanced Features (8):
        • get_caller_info - Analyze method callers
        • get_callee_info - Analyze methods called by target
        • get_call_graph - Generate complete call graphs
        • compare_syntax_trees - Compare syntax trees
        • get_code_diff - Generate code differences
        • diagnostic_fixer - Fix compiler diagnostics
        • quick_fix_provider - Provide quick fixes
        • accessibility_fixer - Fix accessibility issues

      📊 STATISTICS:
        • MCP Tools: 41 → 70 (+29)
        • Test Pass Rate: 100% (190/190)
        • Compilation: Zero warnings, zero errors
        • All Phases: 100% Complete

      🔧 FIXES:
        • Fixed 56 compilation errors
        • Fixed 157 coding standard issues
        • Fixed macOS CI test race conditions

      技术细节：
        • 5,400+ lines of new code
        • 完整的中文和英文文档
        • 跨平台兼容性验证

      v0.6.1 - CI/CD Optimization & Multi-Platform Support

      CI/CD 优化：
      - ✨ 多平台构建支持 - Ubuntu、Windows、macOS 并行测试
      - ✨ NuGet 包缓存 - 使用 actions/cache@v4 加速依赖还原
      - 🚀 智能缓存恢复 - 基于项目文件哈希，支持部分匹配
      - 📈 CI 性能测试阈值优化 - 适应 GitHub Actions 环境
